name: My Paper Plagiarism Checker
tagline: Plagiarism and AI-writing checks for student papers
description: My Paper Plagiarism Checker helps students review essays, research papers and coursework for source overlap and AI-writing indicators. Paste text or upload PDF, Word or text files to review similarity scores, matching sources and highlighted passages, alongside a separate AI-writing score. Free checks support up to 3,000 words and paid credit packs support longer papers. Results are indicators for human review, not proof of plagiarism or AI use.
